entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 206 aa protein with predicted molecular mass 21.95 kDa and basic theoretical pI of 9.61.
Contains a Ham1p_like Pfam domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 12–195 with i-Evalue 3.4e-58.
Has 45.3–50.5% identity and 91.3–95.6% query coverage to curated bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Best-supported inferred function is Mg2+-dependent nucleoside triphosphate pyrophosphatase, EC 3.6.1.66, acting preferentially on dITP, ITP, and XTP.
Exact substrate preference is inferred from homologs and is not experimentally demonstrated for this query sequence.

entities.name: A0LG38 dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Syntrophobacter fumaroxidans; 50.5% identity to the query over 95.6% query coverage.
Annotated as a Mg2+-dependent dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase and homodimer; EC 3.6.1.66.
Hydrolyzes XTP, dITP, and ITP to the corresponding monophosphate plus diphosphate.

entities.name: Noncanonical purine NTP hydrolysis
observations: Representative reactions are XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+, dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+, and ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+.
Mapped to Rhea RHEA:28610, RHEA:28342, and RHEA:29399, respectively.
Reaction assignment for the query is homology-based rather than direct biochemical measurement.
